name: Cat 4 - Slagmaw and the Cooling Line

specialLock.label: Valve Sequence
specialLock.prompt: The trough plate asks: which color cools the red heart?

customItems.name: Blue Valve Key
customItems.description: A cold iron valve-key used to open the emergency cooling line.
customItems.customDescription: A cold iron valve-key used to open the emergency cooling line.

intro.text: An Embervein cooling line is jammed open and the mine below is slowly becoming a throat of lava. Slagmaw, a molten brute born in the clog, is not guarding treasure. It is guarding a disaster.

outro.text: The blue valve finally turns. Steam roars through the Deepworks, and Slagmaw hardens into a harmless black statue with one surprised eye still glowing.

storyTriggers.title: Heat Below
storyTriggers.text: The lift chains are warm. The stone around the shaft sweats mineral water that evaporates before it reaches the floor.

storyTriggers.title: Blue Valve Key
storyTriggers.text: The valve key is cold enough to sting. Its handle is stamped EMERGENCY LINE - DO NOT SELL.

storyTriggers.title: Slag Canal
storyTriggers.text: A black-red canal cuts the chamber. Bubbles rise in it like something below is trying to speak.

storyTriggers.title: Cooling Heart
storyTriggers.text: The furnace heart beats in visible pulses. Slagmaw answers every pulse with a hungry grin.

storyTriggers.title: Cooling Line Opened
storyTriggers.text: The trough drinks the blue key-turn and exhales a wall of white steam. The path to the exit is no longer melting.

designNotes.balancedMonsters: Cat 1-3 forge mobs support one Cat 4 boss.
designNotes.revision: Expanded to seven rooms and roughly 5-8 encounter rooms; hidden doors are one-sided from reachable rooms only.
